summary: The MaintHeader page is part of the HSPnet web application. It is responsible for managing header entries, involving tasks like adding, editing, and deleting entries associated with specific code categories.
purpose: The purpose of the MaintHeader page is to provide a user interface for managing header information, allowing users to maintain entries and associate them with specific categories.

workflows.name: Adding or Editing a Header Entry
steps: User selects a category from the ddCategory dropdown.
User inputs or edits the description in the txtDescription textbox.
User inputs or edits the sort order in the txtSortOrder textbox.
User inputs or edits notes in the txtNotes textbox.
User inputs or edits the alternative description and notes in the txtDescriptionAlt and txtNotesAlt textboxes.
If CodeID is 0, a new entry is added. Otherwise, the existing entry is updated.

workflows.name: Refreshing Data
steps: User changes the selected category in the ddCategory dropdown.
The RefreshData method is called to update the displayed data.

workflows.name: Handling Grid Row Commands
steps: The gridData_RowCommand method listens for commands like cmdAdd, cmdEdit, cmdDelete.
For cmdAdd, the page switches to add mode and shows details.
For cmdEdit, the page switches to edit mode, populates details, and shows them.
For cmdDelete, the specified entry is deleted.

validations: Ensure SortOrder is a numeric value.
system_behavior: Populate categories dropdown on page load.
Hide error and warning panels by default.
exceptions: Error messages are displayed in the pnlError or pnlWarning panels.
